svg.title: DIA-007B · The needle and the works
svg.desc: An engraved plate of a large pressure gauge. Its needle rests near the low end of the scale, marked all well. Part of the face is broken away. Behind it the curved pressure tube and a toothed sector can be seen, and the link that should join the tube to the sector hangs loose. The dial stands for a model's written reasoning, the works for what the model did. Notes give the measured rates: reasoning did not match the act in 65 of 100 cases, no reasoning was left in 87 of 100, and sabotage was carried on in 7 of 100.

The Needle and the Works
DIA-007B · A gauge reports only through the link to its works. Where it matters most, a model's written reasoning is not linked to what it did.
